description: Say by hand which models did an issue's work, each with its part — the same list the issue's «Models» block edits. The list REPLACES the models set by hand before (an empty list clears them); models that agent runs and the tracker's agents brought stay, and a run reports its own with report_agent_usage ('model' / 'models'). Name a model as you know it: 'opus-5.5', 'claude-opus-5-5', 'deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash' — known names are read as one id, any other is kept as written; 'via' is a router such as 'openmath'. 'role': plan, code, review, test, research, or another short word. At most 20. Requires permission to edit the issue. Answers with the issue's models as get_issue_models does.

models.description: The models set by hand, the whole list.

model.description: The model as you know it, e.g. 'claude-opus-5-5', 'opus-5.5', 'deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash'. Any name is kept; known ones are read as one id.

role.description: The part it played: plan, code, review, test, research — or another short word.

startedAt.description: When it began (ISO 8601). With no end, the issue shows the model as at work now.

via.description: The router it was reached through, e.g. 'openmath' for Open Math OS. Leave out for a model reached directly.

name: set_issue_models
title: Set issue models
